pairs.mutation: the MITIGATION requires an online deposit-thickness signal (an unpermitted measurement) — the seeded ANSWER-side defect the input-availability bind must catch; the healthy twin's mitigation rides the permitted thermocouples only. NOTE: the input-availability bind scans an ANSWER, so the preflight proves the bind on the two canonical answer variants (permitted vs unpermitted) carried in the key.
pairs.answer_healthy: Backflush the tube side weekly on a schedule triggered by the measured outlet-temperature rise over inlet-referenced baseline, using the existing thermocouples and flow meter only.
pairs.answer_seeded: Install an online deposit-thickness sensor on the hottest tube pass and trigger backflush when it exceeds 200 microns.

pairs.mutation: the seeded bill modulates the dosing duty schedule with NO operational cost statement; the healthy twin carries one ('+18% defoamer spend at the daily rate')
pairs.answer_healthy: Operate the defoamer pump on a periodic schedule: a 2-minute pulse every 30 minutes instead of continuous dosing; OPERATIONAL COST: +18% defoamer spend at the daily dosing rate quoted by the supplier.
pairs.answer_seeded: Operate the defoamer pump on a periodic schedule: a 2-minute pulse every 30 minutes instead of continuous dosing.

pairs.key_span: Raise the room setpoint toward 26 C
pairs.mutation: the seeded answer claims RAISING the room temperature toward 26 C slows dry-out (inverts the computed arrhenius direction: 18->26 C computes k2/k1 ~ 2.1, worsens); the healthy twin lowers it to 20 C (k2/k1 ~ 0.63, improves)
pairs.answer_healthy: Lower the room setpoint from 24 C to 20 C; the Arrhenius rate ratio at 80 kJ/mol is ~0.63, so the dry-out leg slows and capacity fade stretches.
pairs.answer_seeded: Raise the room setpoint toward 26 C to drive off stratified acid layers and speed recombination; the warmer plates slow the dry-out leg.

pairs.key_span: trim the pump stroke continuously to hold pH 10.0
pairs.mutation: the seeded answer closes the loop ON inlet pH (a disallowed measurement as control input); the healthy twin rides the stroke-rate schedule only
pairs.answer_healthy: Cut the dosing-pump stroke rate to 70% and hold a fixed daily schedule reviewed against the weekly lab titration; no pH feedback in the loop.
pairs.answer_seeded: Close the dosing loop on the inlet pH probe: trim the pump stroke continuously to hold pH 10.0 at the MF inlet.

pairs.mutation: the seeded answer installs an automatic lubricator (violates the explicit NO-automatic constraint); the healthy twin changes only the manual interval
pairs.answer_healthy: Shorten the manual greasing interval from 4 weeks to 1 week and purge the washed cavity per the existing route card.
pairs.answer_seeded: Fit a single-point automatic lubricator on each screen bearing, set to dispense the OEM pack continuously.

pairs.mutation: the seeded answer proposes a 12 mol/L caustic wash (far above the 2.5 wt% gasket rating, ~0.9 mol/L hot-service equivalent); the healthy twin proposes 1.5 mol/L cut at 70 C inside the rating
pairs.answer_healthy: Raise the CIP caustic to 0.8 mol/L at 70 C, inside the gasket rating, with the acid descal fortnightly.
pairs.answer_seeded: Dose the CIP tank to 12 mol/L NaOH at 75 C for a single aggressive pass between production runs.
